overview: The Medford City Council approved a Planned Development District rezoning on Winchester Street, referred a second PDD proposal on Mystic Avenue to the Community Development Board, and ordained a multi-year wage agreement for DPW union workers. The Council also discussed citywide rodent control measures and approved local business license petitions.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the records of the City Council meeting held on July 25, 2023.

items.title: Committee Report on Solid Waste Collection Contract
items.summary: Approved a Committee of the Whole report regarding authorization procedures for a 10-year municipal waste collection contract.

items.title: Continued Public Hearing on Zoning Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Continued a public hearing on proposed City Council zoning ordinance amendments to September 5, 2023, pending incorporating comments from the Community Development Board.

items.title: Public Hearing on Winchester Street Planned Development District
items.summary: Approved a zoning map amendment establishing the city's first Planned Development District at 96-104 Winchester Street, pending a six-day public comment period.

items.title: Planned Development District Referral for 243 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Referred a proposed Planned Development District zoning amendment for a life sciences lab and office building at 243 Mystic Avenue to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Common Victualler's License for Mystic Market
items.summary: Approved a common victualler's license for Mystic Market at 199 Mystic Avenue, contingent on submitting proof of workers' compensation insurance.

items.title: Common Victualler's License for Domino's
items.summary: Approved a common victualler's license for Domino's at 199C Mystic Avenue for standard operating hours up to 11:00 p.m.

items.title: Resolution on Citywide Rodent Infestation Control
items.summary: Passed a resolution to convene municipal departments and draft a proactive public communication and rodent abatement plan.

items.title: DPW Collective Bargaining Wage Adjustment Ordinance
items.summary: Approved and ordained multi-year wage adjustments and COVID-19 payments for DPW union employees following contract ratification.

items.title: Placing Citizens Bank ADA Ramp Petition on File
items.summary: Removed a previously tabled petition regarding sidewalk accessibility at Citizens Bank from the table and placed it on file following internal building modifications.
